title: tbg-kit
description: Open, reproducible pipeline that maps the ownership and control network of Thailand's business groups from public disclosures (SET shareholder registers, Form 56-1 One Reports, DBD BOJ.5 shareholder lists, bank Pillar 3 reports and GLEIF): Claude-assisted table extraction with review queues, Thai and English entity resolution, ultimate ownership with cash-flow and weakest-link control rights, pyramids and control–cash-flow wedges, the link between bank groups and business groups, publication-ready figures, an interactive explorer and an arXiv-style paper whose numbers are filled in automatically. Companion software to the working paper "Mapping Thailand's Business Groups: Ownership, Control, and the Finance-Business Nexus".
